title: Provably Near-Optimal PQ in the Extended Zador Model
abstract: arXiv:2611.31579v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper investigates Product Quantization (PQ) Optimization with Gaussian data. It offers three key contributions (i) a proof that SVD is the optimal preconditioning rotation for PQ; (ii) a new Extended Zador (EZ) estimator of the $k$-means quantization cost that is accurate in low bit rates and low dimensions; and (iii) a novel segmentation algorithm based on 1-d bin packing of global bit allocations. The result is a simple algorithm (EZPQ) with strong approximation guarantees. It matches OPQ's empirical accuracy while providing a per-instance distortion lower bound certificate under the Gaussian EZ cost model. On typical real embedding spectra, EZPQ with 2 bits per coordinate is often certifiably within 1% of the optimum in this model. It also consistently achieves a lower reconstruction error than all random-rotation-based algorithms such as EDEN, E-RaBitQ, and TurboQuant.

translated_title: 扩展Zador模型中可证明近似最优的乘积量化
translated_abstract: 本文研究了针对高斯数据的乘积量化（PQ）优化问题，提出了三项关键贡献： 证明了SVD是PQ的最优预处理旋转； 提出了一种新的扩展Zador（EZ）估计器，用于估计$k$-means量化代价，在低比特率和低维度下依然准确； 提出了一种基于全局比特分配的一维装箱的新型分割算法。最终得到一个具有强近似保证的简单算法（EZPQ）。在高斯EZ代价模型下，它达到了与OPQ相当的经验精度，同时能够提供针对每个实例的失真下界证书。在典型的真实嵌入谱上，每坐标2比特的EZPQ在该模型中通常可证明处于最优值1%以内。此外，相比EDEN、E-RaBitQ和TurboQuant等所有基于随机旋转的算法，它始终能够取得更低的重构误差。
tldr: 本文提出EZPQ算法，通过证明SVD是最优预处理旋转、构建低比特率下准确的扩展Zador代价估计器、以及基于一维装箱的全局比特分配分割方法，实现了具有可证明近似保证且实际性能接近最优的乘积量化。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces EZPQ, a provably near-optimal product quantization algorithm built on the proof that SVD is the optimal preconditioning rotation, a new Extended Zador cost estimator accurate at low bit rates, and a 1-d bin-packing segmentation algorithm for global bit allocation.
